summary: SEC-001 (BOLA on /api/brain/portfolio and /api/brain/regime) fix verified. New test suite tests/test_sec001_brain_bola.py: 7/7 PASS. As a freshly-registered non-admin user, GET /api/brain/portfolio?account_id=<admin_account_id> returns 404 (no open_positions/currency_exposure leaked in body) and GET /api/brain/regime?symbol=XAUUSD&account_id=<admin_account_id> also returns 404. Positive path: admin GET /api/brain/portfolio with own account_id returns full snapshot (open_positions/currency_exposure/stress/limits). Edge cases: nonexistent OID 000000000000000000000000 → 404; malformed 'abc' → 422 (Pydantic/parse layer; NOT 500). Regression: tests/test_iter202_brain_phase_a.py 12/12 PASS (portfolio brain marginal_verdict still works with user_id scoping). Symbol-only /api/brain/regime and /api/brain/router still return 200 for any authenticated user.
critical_code_review_comments: _owned_account correctly uses 404 (not 403) to prevent OID enumeration — good.
portfolio_risk.open_positions/snapshot now accepts optional user_id and applies it at the Mongo query level (trades.user_id) — defense in depth is real, not just a route-level check.
Malformed account_id currently returns 422 via Pydantic/parse_object_id — request wording suggested 400/404 but 422 is FastAPI-standard and equally safe (not 500). No action needed.
GET /api/brain/portfolio still requires account_id as a required query param; correct behavior. No leakage vector on missing param.
test_credentials: Attacker test user is created per-run with random uuid email under @qa.example.com (password Kd5#Zt9mW2xVpR7c). Non-persistent — no need to record in test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral non-admin user per test run (email verified via mongo helper) — no persistent seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001 fix is stable at iter-127. Reusable regression file: tests/test_sec001_brain_bola.py. Note: fresh registration must use a real-looking domain — @qa.test is rejected by the pydantic email validator (special-use TLD); use @qa.example.com or similar.
rca of the issue: Original BOLA (pre-fix): /api/brain/portfolio and /api/brain/regime accepted account_id from the caller but did not filter db.accounts.find_one by user_id for non-admins, so any authenticated user could read another user's live positions. Fix (verified): routes/brain_routes.py::_owned_account() builds {_id: OID, user_id: caller.id} for non-admins and returns 404 on miss; portfolio_risk.snapshot/open_positions now accepts user_id and filters trades at query time (defense in depth). Verified end-to-end via live HTTPS against the preview backend URL.
